# What's the Purpose of Templates?

Source : https://learn.sweego.io/docs/templates/templates_purpose

> With Sweego, you have the ability to utilize email templates.

With Sweego, you have the ability to utilize email templates.

When sending an email, you have two options:

**Static content:** Your email content remains consistent across all recipients.

**Dynamic content:** You can tailor content for each recipient, incorporating basic details like their name, address, etc. This content is accessed through variables created within the application or API, and these variables are populated during the email sending process.

This feature enables you to craft more personalized and engaging emails, which can enhance user experience and boost the effectiveness of your email campaigns.
